name: Animated List
description: Scrollable selectable list of glassy tiles that spring in and out as they enter the viewport, with a spring-driven selection ring, edge fade masks and keyboard navigation.
contents: Framed scroll viewport with a listbox of item tiles (icon or image, title, description, meta)
Spring-animated selection ring that follows the selected item
Top and bottom fade masks and optional custom scrollbar
15 sample file items with Hugeicons icons
behavior: Items animate in and out as they scroll into view, with staggered entrance once the list enters the page
Selection ring glides between items using a damped spring simulation
Hover selects items; arrow keys, Home, End, Enter and Space navigate and activate
Keyboard selection auto-scrolls the selected item into view smoothly
Fade masks at top and bottom grow with scroll position
Reduced motion switches the animation to a plain fade and snaps the ring
editableByProps: Items content (titles, descriptions, meta, icons, images) or fully custom rows via renderItem
Selection behavior: initial index, hover select, arrow navigation, looping, select callback
Dark or light theme, accent color, corner radius, gap, width, max height
Fade masks, fade size, scrollbar visibility, glass frame on or off
Extra classes and inline style on root and items

needsCodeEdit.change: Change theme colors or add a new theme
Change spring feel of entrance or ring
needsCodeEdit.where: SPRING constant and the omega and zeta values in the frame function

fixed: Requires @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons for the default sample icons
Listens for keydown on window; arrow keys work when the list is focused or hovered with nothing else focused, and preventDefault stops page scrolling for those keys
Uses Tailwind utility classes with arbitrary values and CSS variables prefixed --al-
Uses CSS linear() easing spring with a cubic-bezier fallback
Entrance triggers only when the list reaches the viewport (IntersectionObserver, 10% bottom margin)
Text sizes of default item rows are hardcoded
Unknown theme falls back to dark; unknown animation value is treated as none

options.look: Items scale up from 80% while shifting 12px in, with a springy overshoot
options.useWhen: Product UI mockup in a features section where a lively, bouncy list should draw attention

options.look: Items travel 28px vertically with a slight scale, a larger sweeping motion
options.useWhen: Activity feed or changelog list inside a long scrolling page that needs clear directional motion

options.look: Items fade with only a 4px nudge
options.useWhen: Settings or menu panel where motion should stay subtle

options.look: Items always visible with no entrance or exit animation
options.useWhen: Dense data or navigation lists where animation would distract
